admission.justification: Shared clipped text and references must preserve link meaning without turning source syntax into the user-visible contract.

applicability: Markdown/link text rendered by task-page head, note, step and reference surfaces.
conditions: Shown Markdown is rendered rather than exposed as source link syntax.
Reference words are the link and the path is adjacent metadata.
exclusions: Fixing relative non-requirement navigation in the shared Markdown grammar (outside L127).

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/detail-panel/page-look.test.tsx: 'draws a Markdown link as a link and a reference as its words and its place'; notes/reports/worker/7b2c4e19-5d63-4a8f-b1e0-127000000a01/evidence-f6/sandbox/look2-capture.json (rawMarkdownLinks 0 on every form and width)

statement: A link on a task page is drawn as a link: Markdown in notes and step titles is rendered, a reference row is its words as the link with its path beside it, and the text of the page holds no raw Markdown link.
